payload.title: the cli hides its own commands
payload.body: Operator: the top-level help does not list subcommands that exist and are used every day, e.g. `cratylus plan show`, and the other capability verbs (design, plan, note and theirs). Every command and verb must be discoverable from --help at each level, documented once in the CLI README to match, and the CLI's footguns fixed: verbs that write where the operator does not expect, flags that are silently ignored, errors that do not say what to do.
